description: This source file defines the ManagerDBUtil class responsible for database operations related to Manager objects, including validation, insertion, update, and deletion of manager records in the database.

classes.name: ManagerDBUtil
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to perform CRUD operations and validation for Manager entities in the database.

methods.name: validateManager
methods.description: Validates a manager based on email and password by querying the database and returns a Manager object if credentials are correct.

methods.name: insertManager
methods.description: Inserts a new manager into the database by adding an employee record and corresponding manager record.

methods.name: updateManager
methods.description: Updates an existing manager's information, including email, image URL, phone, and password.

methods.name: deleteManager
methods.description: Deletes a manager's records from both manager and employee tables based on EmID.

methods.name: updateManagerWithoutImage
methods.description: Updates a manager's information excluding the image URL, useful for cases where the image remains unchanged.
